name: Canva AI
summary: AI-powered graphic design platform for creating professional images and templates.
description: Canva is the graphic design platform, including its AI tools. Magic Design, at canva.com/magic-design, generates a layout from a prompt inside Canva. It is not a separate product. AI-Powered Design Suggestions: Provides design recommendations based on user input. Magic Write: Generates text content for various design needs. Text-to-Image Tool: Creates images from text prompts. Background Remover: Automatically removes backgrounds from images.

pricing.label: Free
pricing.note: Price label carried over from the previous catalog and not rechecked.

features: AI-Powered Design Suggestions: Provides design recommendations based on user input.
Magic Write: Generates text content for various design needs.

howToUse.title: Sign Up & Open Canva AI
howToUse.description: Create an account and access Canva's AI tools via the dashboard.

howToUse.title: Start or Upload Design
howToUse.description: Choose a template, start a new design, or upload your own image.

howToUse.title: Use AI Features
howToUse.description: Apply Magic Write, text-to-image, or background removal tools.

howToUse.title: Export or Share
howToUse.description: Download, print, or share your finished design.

features_fr: Suggestions de conception basées sur l'IA : fournit des recommandations de conception basées sur les entrées de l'utilisateur.
Magic Write : génère du contenu textuel pour divers besoins de conception.
Outil Text-to-Image : crée des images à partir d'invites de texte.
Background Remover : supprime automatiquement les arrière-plans des images.
